name: OpenFeature Kubernetes Operator (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Kubernetes operator for feature flags, injecting flagd sidecars and exposing flag evaluation via gRPC and HTTP; no software license fee or vendor quota.
watch_out: Requires a user-operated Kubernetes cluster and flagd sidecars; infrastructure and monitoring are not free. The operator resolves cross-namespace resources, with documented multi-tenant isolation risk GHSA-398h-7f66-3h4p; apply upstream mitigations.
